    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    people_patches = image_patch.find("people")
    
    if not people_patches:
        return "No people found in the image."
    
    # Sort people by their vertical center position
    people_patches.sort(key=lambda person: (person.upper + person.lower) / 2)
    
    # Find the person closest to the center of the image
    central_person = people_patches[len(people_patches) // 2]
    
    # Ask LLM what the person is doing
    action = central_person.llm_query("What is the person doing?", long_answer=False).lower()
    
    # Check if the person is standing
    if "standing" in action:
        return f"The person is standing {question}."
    else:
        return f"The person is not standing {question}."
